name: Survey tile in Aquarius
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 2.9 degrees north of the ecliptic in Aquarius, imaged by SPHEREx 15 times in 4 visits over 41 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 30 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 41 hours starting 2025-05-13, at wavelengths from 0.77 to 3.75 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
